Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to proceed with the renewal but need two items clarified before procurement can issue the PO: a) move from a 12-month term to a 24-month term effective at the current anniversary, and b) add +250 concurrent inference seats (projected steady state Q1).

Attached is our latest SOW (Cypress_SOW_v3.pdf) and a short list of questions in the attached spreadsheet. Key commercial/legal asks from our side:
- Add a short addendum that locks pricing for the 24-month term and defines phased billing for the uplift.
- Confirm the termination and early-termination calculation (we propose pro-rata refund on pre-paid months).
- Ensure Exhibit E (Data & Retention) includes our retention window (90 days) and KMS key control language.

Procurement needs a redline/route-to-sign timeline by Thursday EOD so we can align our internal approvers. If legal at Redwood prefers a draft addendum we can review, happy to take it.

Thanks Kerry — appreciate the clear asks and the spreadsheet.

Short summary of next steps from our side:
1) I'll put an initial addendum draft on your desk today that captures the 24-month term, pricing lock, and phased billing schedule for the +250 seats.
2) Laura (contracts) will coordinate redlines against the MSA to confirm the early-termination mechanics and credit treatment.
3) Kimberly (rev ops) will confirm sign-path and whether procurement needs a PO prior to DocuSign.

I've attached a first-pass addendum (Redwood_Addendum_Draft_v1.docx). High-level notes in the draft:
- Section 1 (Term): replaces Section 2.1 of the MSA — term extended to 24 months with automatic renewal opt-out 60 days before term end.
- Section 2 (Pricing): fixed rates for the first 12 months, then a fixed 3% CPI cap for months 13-24 unless mutually agreed otherwise.
- Section 3 (Capacity Uplift): phased ramp 100 -> 250 over 30 days; billing milestone at 100, 175, 250 seats.
- Section 5 (Termination & Refunds): proposes pro-rata refund only for unused pre-paid months; excludes one-time onboarding fees.

Open items I flagged in comments: indemnity carveouts for third-party model usage, SLA credit cap for burst traffic, and explicit KMS export control language.

Can you confirm procurement's preferred signer (legal PO vs SSO DocuSign)? If you want us to route a redline to your legal, we can prepare a comparison table to expedite approval.

Thanks — Jonas

FYI — forwarding Kerry's note and Jonas' draft.

Kimberly / Legal ops: please triage the addendum draft against our standard renewal checklist below and call out anything that will slow sign-off on the Cypress side. I put quick notes inline in the draft where I think we need tighter language.

Redwood checklist for renewals with capacity uplifts:
- Confirm term language replaces only Section 2.1 (no unintended side-effects).
- Ensure billing milestones are explicit (dates or seat thresholds) and that invoicing cadence is monthly after milestone.
- Verify termination formula: pro-rata refund mechanics and whether we allow credits instead of cash refunds.
- Exhibit E: align on 90-day retention and KMS customer-managed key wording.
- SLA: confirm burst tolerance window and maximum credit % (we usually cap at 25% monthly).
- Data residency and audit access: Cypress requires audit logs for the uplift period.

Kerry's deadline: Thursday EOD for routing plan — so legal redlines back to me by Wednesday EOD would be ideal. If you anticipate needing leadership approval for any concessions (price or indemnity), flag now so we can queue exec review.

Forwarded message follows.
